title: Business-Sector Tax Revenue 2024
human_request: how much taxes the government gathered from businesses in year 2024
notes: Period: actual tax collections for revenue year 2024. BudgetKey stores actual 2024 revenue as amount_used on source budget year 2025; code 01.03 is the business-sector income-tax aggregate, not every tax incident on businesses.
query: SELECT 2024 AS revenue_year, year AS source_budget_year, code, title, amount_used AS taxes_gathered_nis, item_url FROM income_items_data WHERE year = 2025 AND code = '01.03' LIMIT 1
